note: Files exempted from named agency/* rules in .oxlintrc.json, with the number of findings each exemption suppresses. The ratchet is bidirectional: a new file is red, a stale exemption is red, a changed count is red. Regenerate with `node scripts/verify/checks/lint-exempt.mjs --write` and say why in the commit.

entries.reason: THE one module allowed to do the arithmetic: bigint `*` and `/`, and the `<`/`>` that implement cmp itself. Exempting it is the premise of the whole rule set, and mirrors the four-module scoping shipped at yagoda-starter/backend/eslint.config.mjs:38-65. It deliberately KEEPS agency/no-numeric-coercion — a Number() or toFixed here is the exact hazard the module exists to prevent. Stays whole-file rather than line-level because 24 findings across 8 of the file's ~200 lines would be 24 comments repeating one sentence; the file-level entry says it once and the count pins it.

The one file in the workspace that is nothing but geometry: `w / (values.length - 1)`, `((v - lo) / span) * (height - 5)` and `${x.toFixed(2)},${y.toFixed(2)}` are an SVG viewBox in pixels, and the 7 findings sit on 3 of its 26 statement lines. Per-line comments here would outnumber the arithmetic they excuse, so this one stays whole-file and counted. It was previously exempted TWICE and inconsistently — 2 coercion findings named here, the other 5 hidden by an unnamed, uncounted `**/kit/src/**` glob in oxlint.base.json — so all three rules are now named in one place with the full count.
